title: 一條送餐的路，成了機械遺產

lines.text: 那部還在店裡工作的輸送機，是最早的那一台嗎？

data.title: 1985 年製；2021 認定時使用中
data.subtitle: 機械遺產 112 · 另存早期魚鱗板

lines.text: 二〇二一年，日本機械學會認定第一百一十二號機械遺產。
其中一台輸送機製於一九八五年，當時仍在元祿壽司堺東店使用。

data.prompt: Close-up on a simple demonstration workbench, one fan-shaped metal sample representing an early turn plate lying apart from a small simplified model of a later conveyor, open tabletop between the two plain objects, soft overhead light.

lines.text: 元祿產業保存的早期「魚鱗板」輸送板片，也一起獲得認定。

data.prompt: Medium shot at a 2021 illustrative archive worktable, one attendant setting a detached early fan-shaped conveyor plate apart from a model of a later whole machine, clear gap between the two objects, soft overhead light.

lines.text: 被保存的早期板片，和那台一九八五年的輸送機，是兩件分開的東西。

data.title: 兩個年代 · 兩件實物
data.subtitle: 早期板片／1985 年製輸送機

lines.text: 早期的扇形板片，回答了當年那個彎怎麼過。
後來仍在店裡運轉的機器，則讓人看到這個辦法沒有只停在第一次試作。

data.prompt: Wide overhead shot of one present-day unbranded Japanese sushi counter, one diner reaching toward a plate that has just rounded a visible corner, open seats and the continuing belt leading toward a plain exit, gentle ceiling light.

lines.text: 送餐的走法變了，客人伸手拿盤這個動作卻留下來。

data.prompt: Wide street-level shot of a present-day unbranded Japanese sushi restaurant, one passerby looking through the window at a conveyor and a diner taking one plate inside, soft overcast daylight.

lines.text: 當初白石把輸送帶帶回小店；別的店又把那條送餐路，改成自己的形狀。

data.prompt: Medium shot from behind one diner at a present-day unbranded sushi counter, their hand hovering above a nearby plate while a smiling profile follows another plate approaching on the belt, the choice held in a single moment, warm lamp light.

lines.text: 你吃迴轉壽司時，會先拿眼前那盤，還是等最想吃的那盤轉過來？
